governing_principles: The kernel decides what work is valuable and admissible; routing decides how that work can be performed
Route != Graph: RouteRegistry references the Wave-3 DecisionGraph substrate without duplicating graph primitives
can_execute != authorized_to_execute: A route with sufficient machinery but insufficient authority is strictly rejected, not penalized
Typed composition invariant: Post(T_i) |= Pre(T_{i+1}) with zero implicit coercion
The GoalSolver decomposes goals and asks kernel for deficiencies; it never falsely decides an unsatisfied goal is satisfied

canonical_types.name: WorkContract
canonical_types.description: Atomic typed capability step with pre/post-conditions, resources, authority, and invariants

canonical_types.name: ResourceRequirement
canonical_types.description: Multi-resource specification {CPU, RAM, GPU, NPU, energy, custom}

canonical_types.name: AuthorityRequirement
canonical_types.description: Role, scope, and audit clearance boundary independent of capability

canonical_types.name: RoutingBudget
canonical_types.description: Multi-dimensional budget envelope bounding cost, resources, and error tolerance

canonical_types.name: Route
canonical_types.description: Typed composition word R = T_n circ ... circ T_1 with fail-closed composition validation

canonical_types.name: RouteCertificate
canonical_types.description: Cryptographically sealed certificate with deterministic SHA-256 digest

canonical_types.name: RouteCandidate
canonical_types.description: Evaluated candidate route with structured qualification status

canonical_types.name: RouteRegistry
canonical_types.description: Contract registry backed by Wave-3 DecisionGraph projection

canonical_types.name: Router
canonical_types.description: Deterministic route discovery engine with multi-constraint fail-closed evaluation

canonical_types.name: Goal
canonical_types.description: Formal objective specification with target signatures, budgets, and constraints

canonical_types.name: GoalConstraint
canonical_types.description: Rule bounding route search (resource, authority, invariant, exclusion)

canonical_types.name: GoalSolver
canonical_types.description: Decomposes goals, extracts deficiencies via Wave-4 kernel, and routes subgoals
